integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the VFW PDF/CDF definition and positive parameter domain, the reliability and hazard formulas, the hazard-shape classification by the sign of the scale parameter, and the positive-parameter inference setup. The original VFW full text was inspected at its positive parameter declaration. The properness trichotomy follows directly from the defining CDF and its derivative, and a standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies parameter-domain properness and excludes the negative-scale hazard branch; it does not classify every interior critical point for positive scale.
The zero-scale formula can be interpreted as a defective lifetime law with mass at infinity, but not as the proper finite-lifetime model estimated in the source.
The source's positive-parameter likelihood and Bayesian computations are not reassessed.
title: The VFW unimodal hazard branch lies outside the probability model
